SparseTrack.definition: Pseudo-depth (bbox bottom y), sort far to near, split into K=4 sparse subsets (every 4th), track each with ByteTrack-like, then global Hungarian assoc across all layer tracks using IOU.
SparseTrack.assumptions: Higher y_bottom = farther, sparse reduces assoc complexity in crowd.
SparseTrack.invariants: Per layer assoc first, then inter-layer.
SparseTrack.steps: 1. Per frame dets sort by depth. 2. Layer dets. 3. Layer trackers. 4. Merge assoc.

ByteTrack.definition: High score match all tracks, low score match unmatched tracks.
